x-gold.evidence_url_rule: The schema requires absolute URLs, so web evidence uses a placeholder origin. Compare evidence and source URLs by path relative to the site root (/index.html, /services.html, /team.html, /policies.html, /contact.html).
x-gold.quote_rule: Each web quote occurs verbatim in the page's visible text (HTML entities decoded, NFC, whitespace collapsed).
